defects: 8 command deep-link anchors 404 to top of page (live ids are #stardustuplift etc.)

keyFacts.answerability: all 4 pages answer their primary question early — home's definition block is first prose after h1

findings.title: Zero structured data on all four pages
findings.evidence: curl: 0 application/ld+json blocks on /, /aem, /docs/, /docs/commands/; only OG meta
findings.businessImpact: Answer engines cannot resolve Stardust as a software entity with license/price/publisher; competing tools with SoftwareApplication markup win the entity slot.
findings.fix: Add SoftwareApplication JSON-LD (name, applicationCategory DeveloperApplication, license Apache-2.0, offers price 0, author Organization Adobe, codeRepository) + Organization + WebSite on home; TechArticle with dateModified on /docs/, /docs/commands/, /aem.

findings.title: 'Free' never stated in crawlable text
findings.evidence: grep all 4 pages: 'free' matches only 'freeform'; Apache 2.0 on home only
findings.businessImpact: Query 'is Stardust free / what does it cost' yields no extractable answer passage on any page.
findings.fix: One explicit sentence on home + /docs/ install: 'Stardust is free and open source under the Apache 2.0 license — there is no paid tier.'

findings.title: All 8 llms.txt command deep-links use non-existent anchors
findings.businessImpact: Agents following llms.txt land at top of a 22KB page instead of the passage — degrades passage retrieval + citation precision.
findings.fix: Rewrite the 8 anchors to real ids, or add stable short ids to the h2s.

findings.title: Home and AEM h2/h3s are slogan-heavy (8/15, 6/10 slogans)
findings.evidence: 'Every design tool promises uniqueness.', 'The seed picks the lane.', 'Web publishing changed under us.' — no askable topic; /docs/ is 7/7 topic-bearing
findings.businessImpact: Slogan headings block passage retrieval for 'how does Stardust work' / 'why AEM Edge Delivery' queries.
findings.fix: Keep slogans as styled eyebrows; make the h2 carry the topic (e.g. 'How Stardust works: extract → direct → prototype → migrate').

findings.title: License/authorship facts live only on the home page
findings.businessImpact: Docs pages (most likely retrieval targets) carry zero trust/provenance facts.
findings.fix: Add the home-footer fact line to the shared footer of all pages.

findings.title: Performance claims unsourced; no freshness signals
findings.evidence: /aem asserts '100/100 Lighthouse' and 'top-decile CWV' with no source/date; no last-updated anywhere
findings.businessImpact: Unsourced superlatives are discounted by answer engines; undated docs lose retrieval weight.
findings.fix: Link CWV claims to aem.live performance docs; add visible 'Last updated' + dateModified schema to docs pages.
